subject: Mystic Lakes Pathway Improvement Project
overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted the Mystic River Watershed Association to discuss shoreline improvements, climate resiliency, and regional greenway connectivity. The program included a detailed project update for the Mystic Lakes pathway and a musical performance by David Fuller and Rollins Ross.

items.title: Mystic River Watershed Association Overview
items.summary: Executive Director Patrick Herron described the organization's mission to improve water quality, climate resiliency, and environmental justice across 21 watershed communities.

items.title: Mystic Lakes Pathway Improvement Project
items.summary: Director Carl Alexander detailed plans to transform a two-mile stretch of unimproved dirt path along the Medford shoreline into an accessible regional parkway.

items.title: Community Engagement and Design Strategy
items.summary: The project team reported receiving over 1,200 public comments to inform design concepts and highlighted the role of a 10-member resident steering committee.

items.title: Climate Change and Infrastructure Challenges
items.summary: Speakers discussed the impact of intense rainfall on aging sewer systems leading to river overflows and the necessity of urban tree canopies to mitigate extreme heat.

items.title: Inclusive Design and Accessibility
items.summary: The discussion emphasized creating a multi-modal space that accommodates ADA requirements, neurodivergent users, and various recreational activities such as cycling and dog walking.

items.title: Project Timeline and DCR Collaboration
items.summary: The association announced a final public meeting for June 11 to present refined design concepts before submitting a formal recommendation report to the Department of Conservation and Recreation.

items.title: WMCC Community Announcements
items.summary: Host Terry Carter shared details for upcoming local events including Juneteenth celebrations, the Hoops for Hope tournament, and West Medford Open Studios.

items.title: Musical Performance
items.summary: David Fuller and Rollins Ross performed a set of soul, jazz, and gospel standards.
